## Flagship: NIH RePORTER pipeline

### Question
How many NIH projects use data science and AI methods each year, and where are they funded?

### Data
NIH ExPORTER bulk files (projects, abstracts, publication links, patents, clinical studies), FY2016 to FY2025: 246,754 project records built from yearly applications. Accessed October 2026.

### Method
- Bulk download, combined to parquet; the RePORTER API fills gaps with retries and rate limiting
- Cleaning: one record per project (`core_project_number`) and subproject; abstracts concatenated across years when they differ; institute and activity codes standardized
- Funding counted once: subprojects keep their own cost and the parent keeps the remainder (`attributed_cost`)
- Linked outputs: iCite (Relative Citation Ratio), OpenAlex (field-weighted citation impact), patents, and clinical studies, cached so reruns are free
- A FastAPI service (`api/main.py`) serves data science projects and trends by taxonomy group
- Packaged as a module (`src/reporter.py`) with tests, so the SQL, ML, and NLP pages reuse the same data

### Results
68,198 records in FY2016 and 72,210 in FY2025, peaking at 78,185 in FY2023. Keywords flagged 50,481 records for model labeling; ChatGPT resolved 29,671 low-confidence calls for about $21.
